item.text:
<linkedin_post>ADT will become the foundation of Thrive Holdings’ smart home security business following an acquisition valued at $15.3 billion including debt. Thrive paid $10 per share, putting the equity value at about $7.6 billion.

Thrive owns more than 75 companies and plans to hold them long term. OpenAI, an investor and partner, supplies those businesses with AI technology and engineers.

The companies plan to invest in new security products, but have shared no details about what they will release. ADT’s existing partnerships with Apple and Google are expected to continue.</linkedin_post>
